_description: Error body for a refused request (HTTP 400; on the WebSocket the same object is the payload of the error frame). Shape: {error, code, reason, index?}. error is the human sentence, as in every other API error; code is always refs_invalid; reason is the stable value to switch on; index (0-based) names the offending element of refs[] when the problem is one element. A link refused for what it is (scheme, credentials, size, private address) is bad_link. Nothing about existence or permission is ever an error here: unavailable entities are reported by refs_resolved, not refused.

body.error: too many references in one message
this reference kind is not available yet
reference id is not a valid UUID
this link is not allowed (http or https only, no credentials, no private address)
search limit is out of range
